name: @go4/marketing-page
description: Self-contained renderer for the go4 collection marketing page. Framework-agnostic React, own scoped styles, zero design-system dependency. Shared by the admin app and the B2B portal.

scripts.build: npm run clean && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --packages=external --jsx=automatic && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
